commands.command: TBD: benchmark M62 and M98 optimized checkpoints under normal reset zero-current zero-all and zero-action ablations before any PPO continuation
commands.name: m99_planned_m98_behavior_retention_gate

decision_rule: Only admit M98 for guarded PPO continuation if behavior retention versus M62 is acceptable and response-history ablations produce meaningful degradation without aggregate collapse.
failure_criteria: M98 aggregate success or clearance margin regresses versus M62
normal M98 behavior is worse than reset or zero-response variants
gate skips ablations and relies only on objective R2
PPO continuation starts before retention artifacts are documented
hypothesis: The M98 objective-only checkpoint may preserve M62 behavior while adding a better no-wheel hidden-envelope belief.
success_criteria: M62 baseline and M98 optimized checkpoints are benchmarked on shared seeds
reset zero-current zero-all and zero-action ablations are included
success and clearance margin are reported
decision states whether guarded PPO continuation is still blocked
